blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Beyond basic tool use and coding skills, effectively incorporating visual references into agentic generation is equally essential for applying AI agents to real-world productivity tasks. We study this crucial capability through webpage development, a practical and readily evaluable setting in which existing benchmarks remain largely idealized: they typically focus on reconstructing visual targets or generating webpages from textual instructions alone, overlooking the more common workflow of developing from visual examples. Specifically, we introduce RefCraft, a benchmark comprising 300 realistic multimodal webpage-development tasks that combine natural-language instructions with screenshots from one to five reference webpages. Agents must selectively interpret and utilize these references while rendering, visually inspecting, and iteratively refining their outputs. We evaluate the resulting open-ended artifacts using independently verifiable keypoints and complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Across nine frontier (M)LLMs, the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12 out of 100, revealing that visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation remains a substantial challenge for current models in practical webpage-development settings.
blocks.zh: 除了基本的工具使用和编码技能外,有效地将视觉参考纳入代理生成对于将AI代理应用于现实世界的生产力任务同样至关重要. 我们通过网页开发来研究这一关键能力,这是一个实用和易于评价的设定,在这一设定中,现有基准在很大程度上仍然是理想化的:它们通常侧重于重建视觉目标,或仅从文字指示中生成网页,忽略了从视觉实例发展起来的更常见工作流程。 具体地说,我们采用了RefCraft,这是一个由300个现实的多模式网页开发任务构成的基准,这些任务将自然语言说明和1至5个参考网页的截图结合起来。 代理人必须有选择地解释和利用这些参考文献,同时制作、视觉检查和反复改进其产出。 我们利用可独立核查的关键点和补充方案及自愿活动法官,评估由此产生的不限成员名额文物。 在9个前沿(M)LLMs中,最强的系统在100个中总得分只有52.12分,揭示出视觉参考条件的代理生成对于实用网页开发环境中的当前模型来说仍然是个巨大的挑战.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: “Creativity is just connecting things.” — Steve Jobs
blocks.zh: “创造力只是连接事物。”

blocks.en: Recently, as coding and co-working assistants, (M)LLMs have transformed numerous fields and substantially improved productivity ( OpenAI, 2026b ; Anthropic, 2026a ; Qwen Team, 2026b ; Kimi et al., 2026 ) . This success has further fueled growing enthusiasm among researchers and practitioners for extending large models to an even broader range of practical tasks, as exemplified by GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026d ) and Claude Fable 5.1 ( Anthropic, 2026b ) . When we scrutinize some common productivity tasks, we find that visual references play an important role: designers may first study successful examples before developing new proposals and then continuously refine their designs through visual inspection, while CAD engineers examine existing parts to design new ones that fit and function properly. This observation highlights that, for both human experts and AI agents, basic tool use and coding skills alone do not encompass the full spectrum of productive capabilities—effectively incorporating visual reference and inspection into agentic generation is equally essential .
blocks.zh: 最近,作为编码和共同工作的助理,(M)LLMs改变了许多领域,并大幅度地提高了生产率(OpenAI,2026b;Anthropic,2026a;Quen Team,2026b;Kimi等,2026.). 这一成功进一步激发了研究人员和从业者对将大型模型推广到范围更广阔的实际任务的越来越大的热情,例如GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026d)和克洛德·菲克5.1(Anthropic,2026b. 当我们仔细研究一些共同的生产力任务时,我们发现视觉参考可以发挥重要作用:设计者可以首先研究成功的例子,然后再制定出新的建议,然后通过视觉检查不断地完善其设计,而CAD工程师则审查现有的部件来设计出适合并正常运行的新部件. 这一意见强调,对人类专家和人工智能代理人来说,仅靠基本工具使用和编码技能并不包括所有生产能力——有效地将视觉参考和检查纳入代理生成同样至关重要。

blocks.en: To evaluate this important yet subtle capability, we ground it in a focused and readily verifiable testbed: webpage development, which is ubiquitous in everyday digital life and produces highly visual, easily assessable outputs. In fact, a growing body of benchmarks has investigated general webpage-related tasks, but most either use natural-language instructions without visual references ( Lu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2025 ) or focus solely on reconstruction tasks, such as reconstructing webpages from screenshots ( Yun et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) or videos ( Chen et al., 2026 ) . More recent studies have broadened the evaluation setting by incorporating interactive operations ( Xiao et al., 2025a ) or introducing webpage editing and repair tasks ( Lei et al., 2026 ) . Nevertheless, we argue that these prior efforts remain academically idealized and differ considerably from common real-world development workflows . In practice, frontend developers and users often begin with a rough design idea and browse existing websites for inspiration. For instance, a user may adopt the appealing layout of a reference website while redesigning its fonts, content, and other elements for a new purpose. Fully reconstructing an existing website is a far less common or representative task. To bridge this gap and, more importantly, evaluate whether AI agents can effectively conduct such a visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation process, we introduce RefCraft.
blocks.zh: 为了评估这一重要而微妙的能力,我们把它放在一个重点突出、易于核查的试验台上:网页开发,在日常数字生活中无所不在,并产生高度可视、易于评估的产出。 事实上,越来越多的基准调查了一般的网页相关任务,但大多数使用自然语言的指令而没有视觉参考(Lu等,2026;Zhu等,2025),或者只专注于重建任务,如从截图上重建网页(Yun等,2024;Wang等,2026)或视频(Chen等,2026). 最近的研究扩大了评价的设定,纳入了互动行动(Xiao等人,2025年a)或引入网页编辑和维修任务(Lei等人,2026年)。 然而,我们争辩说,这些先前的努力在学术上仍然是理想的,与共同的现实世界发展工作流程大相径庭。 在实务中,前端开发者和用户往往会从粗糙的设计理念入手并浏览现有网站以获得灵感. 例如,用户可以在重新设计参考网站的字体、内容和其他内容时采用吸引人的形式,以达到新的目的。 全面重建现有网站是一项远非常见或代表性的任务。 为了弥合这一差距,更重要的是评估AI代理能否有效进行这种可视参考的代理生成过程,我们引入RefCraft.

blocks.en: RefCraft comprises 300 diverse and realistic multimodal queries spanning a broad range of web development scenarios. Each query combines a natural-language user instruction with screenshots from one to five reference webpages, and models solve the task in an inspect-and-iterate setting where they can render and refine intermediate outputs. As shown in Fig. 1 , RefCraft varies substantially in domains, reference composition, and the intended degree of reference utilization—from closely following a reference to selectively adapting its overall style or specific local elements. Evaluating such tasks requires moving beyond conventional target-based evaluation: a query may admit multiple valid solutions, and visual similarity alone cannot determine whether the references have been used appropriately. We therefore decompose each complex and subtle query into a verified set of key points, turning open-ended requirements into independently assessable criteria. Moreover, webpages are both visual and interactive artifacts, encompassing subjective perceptual qualities as well as objective executable behaviors. We thus adopt a dual-track evaluation protocol that uses programmatic judges for deterministic requirements and a VLM judge for perceptual and semantic ones. Together, these designs enable reliable evaluation of whether a generated webpage fulfills the user’s intended use of visual references, rather than merely resembling them.
blocks.zh: RefCraft包含300个不同而现实的多式查询,涵盖广泛的网络开发设想。 每个查询将自然语言的用户指示与一至五个参考网页的截图结合起来,模型在检查和输入的设定中解决了任务,可以在那里提供和完善中间产出. 如图1所示,RefCraft在域、参考组成和预期参考利用程度方面差别很大,从严格参照到有选择地调整其总体风格或具体的地方要素。 评价这些任务需要超越传统的基于目标的评价:一个查询可能承认多种有效的解决方案,光凭视觉相似性无法确定参考文献是否得到适当使用。 因此,我们把每一个复杂而微妙的询问分解成一套经核实的要点,把开放式要求变成可独立评估的标准。 此外,网页既是视觉的,又是互动的,包含主观感知性能以及客观可执行的行为. 因此,我们通过一个双轨评价协议,利用方案法官满足确定性要求,并使用VLM法官满足概念和语义要求。 这些设计加在一起,可以可靠地评价一个生成的网页是否满足了用户对可视参考的预期使用,而不仅仅是类似。

blocks.en: We benchmark 9 frontier (M)LLMs on RefCraft under a unified harness. Despite access to visual references and an inspect-and-iterate workflow, the best-performing system, GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026d ) , achieves an overall score of only 52.12, leaving substantial room for improvement. Component-level results reveal that models often satisfy many individual requirements but fail to realize an essential reference relationship or core behavior. To assess the reliability of RefCraft, we compare its model ranking with both our expert human study and the human-preference leaderboard of Arena.AI 1 1 1 https://arena.ai/leaderboard/code/image-to-webdev , finding strong agreement with both. These findings indicate that current agents can reproduce salient visual attributes but still struggle to translate instruction-dependent reference relationships into coherent designs—precisely the capability that matters to human users.
blocks.zh: 我们用一个统一的控制基准来衡量RefCraft上的9个前沿(M)LLMs。 尽管可访问可视化参考和检查-审阅工作流程,但表现最好的系统GPT-6 Astra(OpenAI,2026d.)总得分只有52.12分,为改进留有相当大的余地. 构成部分层面的结果表明,模型往往满足许多个人要求,但未能实现基本的参考关系或核心行为。 为了评估RefCraft的可靠性,我们把它的模型排名与我们的专家人类研究和Arena的人类优先领导板进行比较。 这些调查结果表明,目前的代理人可以复制突出的视觉特征,但仍难以将依赖教学的参考关系转化为连贯的设计——确切地说,这是对人类用户至关重要的能力。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual-Reference-Conditioned Agentic Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉-参考-有助物剂生成

blocks.en:
In recent years, we have witnessed rapid advances in AI agents. From early frameworks such as ReAct ( Yao et al., 2022 ) to coding agents such as SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) and OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025a ) , substantial effort has been devoted to reasoning, code generation, long-horizon planning, and tool use ( Schick et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . In comparison, vision has received less attention in agentic generation and is typically used only as a perceptual interface for interpreting image or video observations ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Qin et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2024 ) .
Meanwhile, visual inputs serve as important conditioning signals in generative models, particularly diffusion-based models for image and video generation ( Seedance et al., 2026 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) . Yet methods ranging from DreamBooth ( Ruiz et al., 2023 ) and ControlNet ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) to IP-Adapter ( Ye et al., 2023 ) and the OmniGen series ( Xiao et al., 2025c ; Wu et al., 2025 ) often assign predefined, coarse-grained roles to visual references—for example, preserving subject identity, transferring overall style, or imposing structural constraints. Consequently, both prominent research directions leave a challenging yet practical setting underexplored: visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation, where an agent must interpret subtle user instructions and selectively incorporate heterogeneous visual references throughout the agentic generation process.
blocks.zh:
近年来,我们看到AI代理商的迅速进步. 从早期框架如ReAct(姚等,2022年)到SWE-agent(杨等,2024年)和OpenHands(王等,2025年a)等编码剂,在推理,代码生成,长视规划和工具使用等方面投入了大量精力(史克等,2023年;王等,2024年;杨等,2026年). 相较之下,视觉在代理生成中受到的关注较少,通常仅被作为感知界面来解释图像或视频观测(谢等,2024;秦等,2025;陈等,2024.
同时,视觉输入在基因模型中,尤其是以传播为基础的图像和视频生成模型中充当重要的调节信号(《种子》等,2026;《白等》,2025;《王等》,2025b)。 然而,从DreamBooth(Ruiz等,2023年)和控制网(Zhang等,2023年)到IP-Adapter(Ye等,2023年)和OmniGen系列(Xiao等,2025年c; Wu et al., 2025.)经常为视觉参考指定预先定义的,粗糙而粗糙的角色——例如保留主题身份,转移整体风格,或施加结构上的限制. 因此,两个突出的研究方向都留下了具有挑战性但实用性的未加探讨的背景:视觉参考-有条件的代理生成,其中代理生成者必须解释微妙的用户指示,并在整个代理生成过程中有选择地纳入多样的可视参考.

blocks.en: 2.2 Web Development Benchmarks
blocks.zh: 2.2 网络开发 基准

blocks.en:
Existing web development benchmarks broadly follow two task formulations. Text-driven benchmarks, such as WebGen-Bench ( Lu et al., 2026 ) and FrontendBench ( Zhu et al., 2025 ) , ask models to construct webpages or applications from natural-language specifications ( Tran et al., 2026 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Visual-target benchmarks instead formulate generation as reconstruction, including screenshot-to-code tasks such as Design2Code ( Si et al., 2025 ) and Web2Code ( Yun et al., 2024 ) , video- or interaction-conditioned generation ( Chen et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2025a ) , and sketch-to-code generation ( Jain et al., 2019 ) . More recent benchmarks, including DesignBench ( Xiao et al., 2025b ) , ArtifactsBench ( Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and WebCompass ( Lei et al., 2026 ) , extend beyond one-shot generation to interactive behavior, editing, repair, and multi-turn refinement ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Saxena et al., 2026 ) .
Evaluation for these tasks has evolved accordingly, moving from visual-similarity measures based on CLIP features ( Radford et al., 2021 ) , layout blocks, colors, and positions ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Si et al., 2025 ) toward MLLM- or agent-as-a-judge evaluation over rendered webpages ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Lei et al., 2026 ; Zhuge et al., 2024 ) . Nevertheless, existing benchmarks typically treat visual input as a target to reconstruct or an artifact to edit. They rarely capture the common workflow in which users consult one or more webpages as partial design references, which is precisely the setting studied in our work.
blocks.zh:
现有网络发展基准大致遵循两项任务安排。 由文字驱动的基准,如WebGen-Bench(Lu等,2026年)和Frontend Bench(Zhu等,2025年),要求模型从自然语言规格构建网页或应用(Tran等,2026年;徐等,2025年). 视觉目标基准将生成作为重建,包括截图到代码的任务,如Design2Code(Si等,2025年)和Web2Code(Yun等,2024年),视频或互动条件生成(Chen等,2026年;Shao等,2025年a),以及草图到代码生成. (Jain等, 2019). 最近的基准,包括Bench设计(Xiao等,2025b),Artifacts Bench (Zhang等,2025年)和WebCompass (Lei等,2026年) 超越一发相代,扩展到交互行为,编辑,修复和多回转改进(Yang等,2025年;Sun等,2025年;Saxena等,2026年).
对这些任务的评价也相应演变,从基于CLIP特征的视觉-同质性措施(Radford等,2021年),布局块,颜色和位置(Wang等,2026年;Si等,2025年),转向对制作的网页进行MLLM-或代理-a-judge评价(Zhang等,2025年;Lei等,2026年;Zhuge等,2024年)。 尽管如此,现有的基准通常将视觉输入视为重建目标或编辑文物. 它们很少捕捉用户查阅一个或多个网页作为部分设计参考的共同工作流程,这正是我们工作中研究的设置.

blocks.en: 3 Benchmark Design
blocks.zh: 3 基准设计

blocks.en: Fig. 2 presents the overall design of RefCraft. Each benchmark instance, corresponding to a single task, consists of a textual user query, one to five visual references, and a verified set of evaluation keypoints. We construct these instances in three stages: curating a diverse reference pool (§ 3.2 ), synthesizing controllable user queries (§ 3.3 ), and decomposing each query into independently verifiable keypoints (§ 3.4 ). Further implementation details are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 图2介绍了RefCraft的整体设计. 每个基准实例与一项单一任务相对应,包括文字用户查询,一到五个可视参考,以及一套经过核实的评价关键点. 我们分三个阶段构建这些实例:管理不同的参考集合(§3.2),合成可控制的用户查询(§3.3),将每个查询分解为独立可核查的键点(§3.4)。 进一步的实施工作详情见附录B。

blocks.en: 3.2 Reference Pool Curation
blocks.zh: 3.2 参考资料库说明

blocks.en:
Reference webpages are important because they determine what information an agent can draw upon and therefore form the foundation of RefCraft. We curate the reference webpage pool according to three principles: diversity , covering a broad range of topics and design styles; visual richness , providing sufficiently salient properties for users to reference and evaluators to verify; and realism , reflecting designs that may plausibly appear in practical development workflows.
Following these principles, we combine three sources: (1) openly licensed websites and webpage templates; (2) conventionally styled webpages synthesized by multiple models to increase diversity; and (3) deliberately synthesized webpages that deviate from conventional modern styles and common model-generated patterns. The rationale is that synthesized pages may inherit common model priors, allowing an agent to produce superficially similar designs based on its prior knowledge without consulting the references. To mitigate this shortcut, the third group incorporates less conventional visual characteristics, such as unusual color palettes, uncommon font combinations, and hard-edged shadows.
blocks.zh:
参考网页很重要,因为它们决定了一个代理能够利用哪些信息,因此构成了RefCraft的基础. 我们按照三项原则管理参考网页库:多样性,涵盖广泛的专题和设计风格;视觉丰富性,为用户提供足够突出的属性,供参考和评价人员核实;现实性,反映在实际发展工作流程中可能合理出现的设计。
遵循这些原则,我们综合了三个来源:(1)公开许可的网站和网页模板;(2)由多种模式合成的常规风格网页来增加多样性;(3)有意合成的网页偏离了传统的现代风格和常见的模型生成模式. 其原理是被合成的页面可能继承了常见的模型前作,允许一个代理基于其先前的知识而无需查阅参考文献而制作出表面相似的设计. 为了减轻这种快捷键,第三组包含了不太常规的视觉特征,例如不寻常的色调调,不寻常的字体组合,和硬化的阴影.

blocks.en:
We represent each reference using images rather than source code or a live URL, preventing implementation details from leaking to the evaluated agent and better reflecting practical scenarios. Because a single static screenshot cannot expose dynamic properties such as hover effects or interactive state changes, we use Playwright 2 2 2 https://playwright.dev/ to capture a sequence of visual frames along scripted interaction traces involving scrolling, hovering, clicking, typing, and key presses.
To support subsequent task construction, we also profile the observable information in each reference along six dimensions: layout , palette , typography , components , interaction , and overall visual character . Each dimension is annotated as rich , weak , or none , together with a concise description of the observed evidence. This profile prevents later queries from referring to properties that are absent or visually ambiguous.
blocks.zh:
我们使用图像而不是源代码或活的URL来代表每一个参考,防止执行细节泄露给被评价代理人并更好地反映实际情景. 由于单个静态截图不能暴露出诸如悬浮效应或交互状态变化等动态属性,我们使用Playwright 2 2 https://playwright.dev/沿脚本互动痕迹捕捉一系列可视框架,涉及滚动,徘徊,点击,打字,和按键等.
为了支持随后的任务构建,我们还将每个参考文献中的可观测信息按照六个维度进行描述:布局、调色板、打字、组件、相互作用和整体视觉特征。 每个维度均被注为丰富、弱或无,同时对观测到的证据作简要的说明。 此配置可防止以后的查询提及不存在或视觉模糊的属性.

blocks.en: 3.3 Controllable Query Synthesis
blocks.zh: 3.3 可控查询合成

blocks.en: Directly prompting an LLM to generate user queries leads to substantial mode collapse: the resulting instructions are often similarly phrased and repeatedly emphasize only a small subset of the available reference information. We instead adopt a specification-first approach: we first determine the intended reference usage and task composition and then verbalize them as a natural user request.

blocks.en: 3.4 Verifiable Keypoint Construction
blocks.zh: 3.4 可核实的关键点建设

blocks.en:
A query in RefCraft may admit many valid implementations, and its requirements can be fine-grained, subtle, and distributed across both language and visual references. Consequently, evaluating against a single canonical webpage or a holistic similarity score would be inappropriate. Inspired by rubric-based evaluation ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Hashemi et al., 2024 ; Pathak et al., 2025 ) , we instead decompose each query into a set of non-overlapping keypoints, each capturing one independently assessable requirement.
We partition 𝒦 t = 𝒦 t prog ∪ ˙ 𝒦 t vlm \mathcal{K}_{t}=\mathcal{K}_{t}^{\mathrm{prog}}\mathbin{\dot{\cup}}\mathcal{K}_{t}^{\mathrm{vlm}} into disjoint tracks according to how each keypoint can be most reliably verified. Program-verifiable keypoints 𝒦 t prog \mathcal{K}_{t}^{\mathrm{prog}} capture deterministic properties such as color distance, contrast, responsive behavior, DOM state changes, and robustness to abnormal content. The remaining keypoints require semantic or perceptual judgment and are assigned to the VLM-assessed track 𝒦 t vlm \mathcal{K}_{t}^{\mathrm{vlm}} . We follow the principle that whenever reliable deterministic verification is possible, we favor the programmatic track to reduce reliance on VLM judgments, which can be overly lenient. We additionally designate essential user requirements and page-integrity constraints as critical items, ensuring that they receive greater emphasis in the final evaluation.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 4. 评价议定书

blocks.en: Given the benchmark instances constructed above, our evaluation protocol standardizes how models interact with the task, converts their unconstrained HTML outputs into structured evidence, and scores them against the corresponding keypoints.
blocks.zh: 鉴于以上构建的基准实例,我们的评价协议将模型如何与任务互动标准化,将其不受约束的HTML输出转换为结构化的证据,并按相应的关键点进行评分.

blocks.en: 4.1 Unified Agentic Environment
blocks.zh: 4.1 统一的代理环境

blocks.en:
We evaluate each model as a coding agent, reflecting the increasingly common use of agentic harnesses in practical development workflows (
              ) . To ensure comparability, all models operate through the same open-source coding harness, opencode 3 3 3 https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode , with identical tools, workspace structure, and output requirements.
For each task, the agent receives the user instruction, visual references, and an environment brief. It is given a dedicated working directory and may render, screenshot, and inspect intermediate implementations before revising them. The final result must be stored as a single self-contained HTML file, ensuring a uniform artifact format across models.
We restrict access that could reveal benchmark internals or ground-truth evaluation criteria. Each working directory is isolated from the benchmark repository, and attempts to access the repository or evaluation keypoints are denied. Network access remains available to preserve a realistic coding environment, but searching for or downloading the original source of a reference webpage invalidates the run.

每个任务,代理都收到用户指令,可视化参考,以及一份环境简报. 它有一个专门的工作目录,在修订之前可以制作、截取和检查中间执行。 最终结果必须作为单一自成一体的HTML文件被存储,确保跨模型的统一文物格式.

blocks.zh: 4.2 收集证据

blocks.en:
Generated HTML files vary substantially in structure and may exhibit visual and interactive behaviors that cannot be reliably evaluated from source code alone. Therefore, for each artifact h m , t h_{m,t} , we collect structured evidence ℰ m , t = ( 𝒱 m , t , ℳ m , t ) \mathcal{E}_{m,t}=(\mathcal{V}_{m,t},\mathcal{M}_{m,t}) , where 𝒱 m , t \mathcal{V}_{m,t} contains captured views and ℳ m , t \mathcal{M}_{m,t} contains browser measurements. Specifically, for each benchmark instance, we derive a task-specific capture script specifying a sequence of actions, such as scrolling, hovering, clicking, and typing. The script is designed to expose the page states required to evaluate as many relevant keypoints as possible. We load the generated HTML in Playwright, execute the actions sequentially, and capture screenshots of the resulting states.
In parallel, we apply a fixed suite of browser-based measurements to assess properties such as rendering integrity, responsive behavior, robustness to abnormal content, and whether interactive controls produce genuine state changes. Together, the screenshots and measurements provide downstream judges with targeted evidence rather than requiring them to infer page behavior from raw HTML, which would be poorly aligned with practical usage.

blocks.en: 5.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We evaluate nine frontier models—GPT-6 Astra ( OpenAI, 2026d ) , Claude Fable 5 ( Anthropic, 2026a ) , Qwen3.8-Max ( Qwen Team, 2026b ) , Grok 4.6 ( xAI, 2026 ) , Kimi K3 ( Kimi et al., 2026 ) , GLM-5.3 ( Z.ai, 2026 ) , DeepSeek-V4-Pro ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , Seed2.1 Pro ( ByteDance Seed Team, 2026b ) , and Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) —as coding agents on RefCraft. All models are evaluated using the same OpenCode v1.18.25 harness, with high reasoning effort and a maximum of 100 turns. Keypoints are generated by Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026f ) and verified by GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026c ) . We use Gemini 3.1 Pro as the VLM judge. We report the overall score S S together with its three constituent metrics. Further details are provided in Appendix B .

Using an equal-weight average across models, palette (92.4), layout (83.1), and components (82.2) score higher than typography (76.1) and overall visual character (58.8). Models perform best on invert (98.87) and specify (87.68), followed by copy (82.42), whereas adapt receives the lowest score (75.49). blocks.en: 5.3.2 Reference Utilization and Visual Inspection Capabilities
blocks.zh: 5.3.2 参考利用和视觉检查能力

blocks.en:
As discussed in § 1 , effectively incorporating visual references and refining intermediate outputs through visual inspection are important capabilities in agentic generation. We assess these capabilities via our RefCraft. (1) Reference ablation. We remove all visual references while leaving the original user query unchanged. The agent is explicitly informed that the references mentioned in the query are unavailable and is instructed to satisfy all requirements using its prior knowledge to make reasonable choices. (2) Pre- and post-inspection comparison. We evaluate the artifact produced in the first generation round, before the agent receives a rendered view of its output, and compare it with the final artifact.
The results are reported in Tab. 3 . Removing the visual references substantially reduces performance for both models. GPT-6 Astra drops from 52.1 to 17.3 points in overall score, while DeepSeek-V4-Pro drops from 37.1 to 11.1. These results indicate that effectively incorporating the supplied visual references is a crucial capability and that models cannot recover the reference-dependent requirements from the textual query and their priors alone.
We also observe that performance improves from the initial to the final artifacts when models have additional opportunities to inspect and revise their outputs. Although this comparison does not rigorously isolate the causal contribution of visual inspection, since the final artifacts also benefit from additional tool calls, the consistent improvements suggest that the complete inspection-and-revision process is important.

我们还注意到,当模型有更多机会检查和修订其产出时,业绩从最初的文物到最后的文物都有所改进。 虽然这种比较没有严格区分视觉检查的因果贡献,因为最后的文物也受益于其他工具的调用,但持续的改进表明,完整的检查和修订过程是重要的。

blocks.en:
To assess the reliability of our evaluation protocol, we sample 100 model–task artifacts and recruit ten web-development experts to evaluate each artifact independently. We aggregate the expert judgments using the median label for each keypoint and the mean score for each task.
As shown in Tab. 3 , the evaluator achieves substantial agreement with the expert consensus, both overall and across evaluation aspects, with a weighted κ \kappa of 0.64 0.64 across all keypoints. More subjective criteria, such as overall visual character, exhibit greater human–human and evaluator–human disagreement, as expected. The task-level scores also correlate strongly with the mean expert scores (Pearson r = 0.747 r=0.747 ), indicating that this alignment extends to aggregate assessments of task performance.
We further compare our overall model ranking with the Image-to-Webdev leaderboard from Arena.AI, a popular platform for human evaluation of frontier models 4 4 4 https://arena.ai/leaderboard/code/image-to-webdev , accessed September 24, 2026. . The two rankings achieve a Spearman correlation of ρ = 0.89 \rho=0.89 , suggesting broad consistency between RefCraft and real-world user needs and preferences.

Fig. 4 presents two qualitative failure cases detected by RefCraft. In Task 96, Kimi K3 produces a polished news-timeline page that satisfies many keypoints and all core goals. Yet it adopts a centered, single-column feed rather than the requested full-width, two-column image–text layout, thereby failing the reference requirement.
In Task 123, Grok 4.6 produces a step sequencer that follows the visual references, but its save function fails to retain edits, although edit persistence is explicitly requested in the query and can be implemented in JavaScript. Together, these cases illustrate how RefCraft identifies both unmet reference requirements and broken core functionality.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduced RefCraft, a benchmark for studying reference-based webpage development and, more broadly, visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation in frontier models. RefCraft comprises 300 realistic web-development tasks in an inspect-and-iterate setting. We decompose each query into independently verifiable keypoints and evaluate the generated artifacts using complementary programmatic and VLM judges. Our evaluation of nine frontier (M)LLMs shows that this capability remains far from solved: the strongest system achieves an overall score of only 52.12. We hope that RefCraft will provide a valuable testbed for this crucial yet underexplored capability and stimulate further progress in visual-reference-conditioned agentic generation.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们介绍了RefCraft,这是研究基于参考网页开发的基准,更广泛地说,是前沿模型中具有可视参考条件的代理生成。 RefCraft包含300个在检查和审阅环境中的现实的网络开发任务。 我们利用补充方案判断和虚拟LM判断,将每个查询分解为可独立核查的关键点,并评估生成的文物。 我们对9个前沿(M)LLMs的评价表明,这种能力远远没有解决:最强系统的总得分只有52.12分。 我们希望RefCraft将为这一关键但未得到充分开发的能力提供一个宝贵的试验台,并激励在视觉参考条件代理生成方面取得进一步进展。

blocks.en: A.1 Benchmark Statistics
blocks.zh: A.1 基准统计

blocks.en: We summarize the composition of RefCraft in Fig. 5 . The final 300 tasks span eight application domains, 40 subdomains, and 186 distinct webpage types. Each task uses one to five reference webpages, with three- and four-reference tasks accounting for 78 and 72 instances, respectively. The benchmark also varies the intended degree of reference use, from loose guidance to near-copying, as determined by requirement types such as adapt and copy , and includes 151 English and 149 Chinese requests. Together, these distributions capture variation in both what agents are asked to build and how they should use the supplied references. The 744-page reference pool is counted separately because each source page may support multiple tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们在图5中总结了RefCraft的构成。 最后300项任务涉及8个应用域、40个子域和186个不同的网页类型。 每个任务使用一至五个参考网页,三个和四个参考任务分别占78个和72个案例。 该基准还根据适应和复制等要求类型,对预期的参考使用程度有不同,从松散的指导到接近复制,包括151个英文请求和149个中文请求。 这些分布加在一起,既可以捕捉要求建立何种物剂,又可以捕捉它们应如何使用所提供的参考物。 744页的参考集合单独计算,因为每个源页可能支持多个任务.

blocks.en: During evaluation, each keypoint is instantiated as a single evaluation record. This process yields 12,682 records, comprising 10,542 VLM-assessed criteria, 1,540 programmatic probes, and 600 renderability records. The first two categories form the 12,082-item score-bearing set, whereas the renderability records support auditing and core evaluation without contributing additional scoring items. Within the score-bearing set, 3,106 criteria assess directive-related requirements; Fig. 5 (d) presents their breakdown.

blocks.en: A.3 Judge Sensitivity and Stability
blocks.zh: A.3 敏感和稳定法官

blocks.en: In our evaluation, we use Gemini 3.1 Pro as the VLM judge. A natural question is whether the broad model comparison depends on the choice of automatic evaluator. We examine this sensitivity by re-scoring artifacts from the nine evaluated systems on a fixed 32-task sample using Gemini 3.1 Pro, GPT-6 Astra, and Claude Opus 5. Each judge receives identical tasks, keypoints, reference mappings, rendered views, browser measurements, and interaction evidence. As shown in Fig. 6 , the three judges produce similar model-level score patterns, suggesting that the broad comparison on this sample is not specific to a single evaluator.
blocks.zh: 在我们的评价中,我们使用双子座3.1 Pro作为VLM法官. 一个自然的问题是,广义的模型比较是否取决于自动评价员的选择. 我们利用双子座3.1 Pro、GPT-6 Astra和克洛德·奥普斯5,在固定的32个任务样本上重新评分9个系统的文物,以此审查这种敏感性。 每个法官都得到相同的任务、关键点、参考图、视图、浏览器测量和互动证据。 如图6所显示,三位评委制作的模型级分数模式相近,说明本样本的广泛比较并不针对单一评价者.

Pairwise correlations between repeated scores reach 0.92, indicating that the overall score pattern is reproducible across runs.

blocks.en: A.4 Evaluation Protocol Ablations
blocks.zh: A.4 评价议定书的缺陷

blocks.en: The protocol in § 4 combines requirement-level assessment with visual and executable evidence. To examine the role of these design choices, we compare the complete protocol with two plausible alternatives on the same generated artifacts. Holistic evaluation replaces keypoint decomposition and B / C / R B/C/R aggregation with a direct overall rating, testing how the assessment changes when requirements are no longer scored and aggregated separately. Screenshot-only evaluation retains the rendered images but removes browser measurements and action traces, testing what can be established from visual evidence alone.
blocks.zh: §4中的协议将要求级别的评估与可视性和可执行性的证据相结合. 为了审查这些设计选择的作用,我们比较了完整的协议和在同一个生成的文物上的两个可行的替代品。 整体评价用直接的总体评级取代了关键点分解和B / C / R B/C / R 汇总,测试在需求不再得分和单独汇总时评估如何变化. 只有屏幕截图的评价保留了已渲染的图像,但删除了浏览器的测量和动作痕迹,测试了仅从视觉证据中可以确定的东西.

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 7 , holistic scores exceed complete-protocol scores by 42.3 points. Because holistic evaluation changes both the rating granularity and the aggregation rule, this gap alone cannot establish which protocol better captures artifact quality. Nevertheless, the large increase suggests that holistic evaluation may overestimate model capabilities by overlooking failures exposed by the complete protocol.
Removing executable evidence has a clearer effect on evaluation coverage. Unresolved core cases increase from 26 to 437 out of 918, while unresolved keypoints increase from 15 to 1,987 out of 7,608. These results indicate that visual evidence alone is often insufficient to determine whether requirements are satisfied, making screenshot-only evaluation incomplete and unreliable for assessing overall artifact behavior.

如图7所示,整体分数以42.3分的分数超过完整-正谱分数. 由于整体评价既改变了评级颗粒性,也改变了汇总规则,因此仅凭这一差距无法确定哪个协议能更好地捕捉出文物质量. 然而,大幅增加表明,整体评价可能通过忽略整个协议暴露的失败而高估模型能力。
删除可执行的证据对评价范围有更明确的影响。 918起未解决的核心案件从26起增加到437起,而7 608起未解决的关键问题从15起增加到1 987起。 这些结果表明,光凭视觉证据往往不足以确定是否满足要求,使得只进行截图评价对于评估整体文物行为来说是不完整和不可靠的.

To test sensitivity to the choice of harness, we evaluate GPT-6 Astra and Kimi K3 on a fixed 32-task sample using two popular alternatives: Claude Code 5 5 5 https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code and Codex 6 6 6 https://github.com/openai/codex . blocks.en: Fig. 9 traces how GPT-6 Astra, running in OpenCode, completes Task 163: a marine repair quote builder. The model first identifies which properties to borrow from each reference and which to avoid, combining bold typography and light service cards while rejecting the dark reference palette. It then builds a self-contained index.html , inspects rendered views, and revises the tablet heading and booking controls. Functional checks verify that repair selections update the quote and that editing a confirmed plan reopens the booking form; the final page also shows no horizontal overflow across 13 tested widths. This example illustrates how reference interpretation, visual refinement, and interaction testing work together to turn a user request into a functional webpage.

blocks.en: Appendix B Additional Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 附录B

blocks.en: § 3 and § 4 describe the design of RefCraft and its evaluation protocol. Here, we explain how these designs are implemented. We follow the same progression as the main text: reference webpages are first converted into visual evidence, which supports the construction of user requests and their evaluation keypoints. Once these task components are fixed, an agent uses the request and reference images to develop a webpage, while a separate evaluator assesses the submitted artifact against the hidden keypoints. The details below apply to the RefCraft benchmark and clarify how information passes between these stages.
blocks.zh: §3和§4描述了RefCraft的设计及其评价协议. 在这里,我们解释这些设计是如何实施的。 我们遵循与正文相同的进展:参考网页首先被转换成可视证据,支持构建用户请求及其评价关键点. 一旦这些任务组件固定下来,一个代理商就会使用请求和参考图像来开发一个网页,而一个单独的评估者则对照隐藏的键点来评估提交的文物. 以下细节适用于RefCraft基准,并澄清信息如何在这些阶段之间传递。

blocks.en: B.1 Reference Collection and Visual Evidence
blocks.zh: B.1 参考资料收集和视觉证据

blocks.en: We begin by preparing a reusable collection of webpages from which task-specific references can be assembled. Following the three-source design in § 3.2 , this collection contains 744 pages: 444 openly licensed template-derived pages, 200 conventionally styled synthetic pages, and 100 atypical synthetic pages. These counts describe the available source pool rather than the benchmark instances. A task draws visual references from one to five source pages, and the same source page may support different requests that ask agents to use its properties in different ways.
blocks.zh: 我们首先准备一个可重复使用的网页集,从中收集具体任务的参考文献。 遵照§3.2中的三源设计,本集包含744页:444个公开许可的模板出自页面,200个常规风格的合成页面,和100个非典型的合成页面. 这些计数描述的是可用的源集合,而不是基准实例. 一个任务从1到5个源页引出可视引用,同一个源页可能支持不同的请求,要求代理以不同方式使用其属性.

blocks.en: For the template-derived portion, we collect openly licensed pages from collections including HTML5 UP , Colorlib , Start Bootstrap , Creative Tim , AdminLTE , Themefisher , and CodeWithSadee . The retained copies comprise 367 MIT-licensed pages, 76 under CC BY 3.0, and one under Apache-2.0. For each page, we record its source URL, author, license, and design-family identifier, preserving the connection between the benchmark reference and its original source. We also package the page’s styles, scripts, and image assets into a self-contained HTML snapshot. This snapshot provides a stable input to the capture process: the browser renders the stored page rather than relying on the continued availability or current appearance of the live website.
blocks.zh: 包括HTML5 UP、Colorlib、Start Bootstrap、Creative Tim、AdminLTE、Chomafisher和CodeWithSade等。 保留的副本包括367份麻省理工学院许可证,76份载于CC BY 3.0,1份载于Apache-2.0。 对于每一页,我们记录其源的URL,作者,许可证,以及设计-家庭标识符,保留基准参考与其原始来源之间的联系. 我们还将页面的样式、脚本和图像资产打包成自成一体的HTML快照。 此快照为抓取过程提供了稳定的输入:浏览器使被存储的页面不依赖于直播网站的持续可用性或当前外观.

blocks.en: The synthetic portion complements these existing templates by extending the range of designs available for task construction. Across the 300 synthetic pages, we use GPT-5.2 and GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2025 ; OpenAI, 2026a ) , Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.8, and Claude Sonnet 4.6 ( Anthropic, 2025 ; Anthropic, 2026c ; Anthropic, 2026d ; Anthropic, 2026e ) , Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) , Qwen3.6-Plus ( Qwen Team, 2026a ) , Seed2.0 Pro ( ByteDance Seed Team, 2026a ) , GLM-5 ( GLM-5 Team et al., 2026 ) , and MiniMax M2.7 ( MiniMax, 2026 ) as reference generators. As discussed in the main text, however, model-generated pages can themselves converge on familiar design patterns. For the 100 atypical pages, we therefore pair a controlled design sampler with Claude Opus 4.8 ( Anthropic, 2026d ) to introduce less conventional visual combinations. The sampler combines 16 predefined design families (e.g., Swiss typography 7 7 7 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swiss_Style_(design) , brutalism, and terminal interfaces) with varied palettes and family-specific font stacks, using flat fills, square corners, and optional hard shadows. The model then refines the copy and page structure, while automated checks enforce the palette, font, and styling constraints. These models participate in constructing the reference pool, a role distinct from that of the nine systems subsequently evaluated on the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 合成部分通过扩大任务构建可用的设计范围来补充这些已存在的模板. 在300个合成页面中,我们使用GPT-5.2和GPT-5.4(OpenAI,2025;OpenAI,2026a),克洛德·奥普斯 4.5,克洛德·奥普斯 4.6,克洛德·奥普斯 4.8和克洛德·索内特 4.6(Anthropic,2025;Anthropic,2026c;Anthropic,2026d;Anthropic,2026e;Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google DeepMind,2026;Quen Team,2026a;Seed2.0 Pro (BteDance Seed Team,2026a;GLM-5 (GLM-5 Team等;2026;和Minimax M2.7 (Minimax,2026))作为参考发电机. 然而,如正文所讨论,模型生成的页面本身可以聚合到熟悉的设计模式上. 因此,对于100个非典型的页面,我们与克洛德·奥普斯·4.8(Anthropic, 2026d.)配对一个可控设计采样器,以引入不太传统的视觉组合. 采样器结合了16个预定义的设计家族(如:瑞士打字法7 7 https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Swiss_Style_(design),残暴主义,和终端界面),使用各种调色板和家族特有字体堆放,使用平面填充,平面角和可选硬阴影. 该型号随后完善了拷贝和页面结构,而自动检查则强制调色板,字体,和样式限制. 这些模型参与建立参考库,这一作用不同于后来根据基准评估的9个系统。

blocks.en:
The stored webpages are construction assets, but the references shown to agents consist only of images. To produce these visual inputs, Playwright renders each page at a 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 viewport and captures scripted scrolling and interaction states, yielding 5,522 frames across the pool. For conventionally styled synthetic pages, we retain their original page-specific demonstration scripts. For template-derived and atypical pages, we generate scripts from the measured page height and available hover targets (identified through known selectors or DOM probing), interleaving stepwise scrolling, hovers, and short pauses. We retain the capture-action script and a time-stamped frame manifest for each page so that the resulting images remain associated with the actions and source that produced them. When references are assembled into a task, frame order and source-page boundaries are preserved. The agent can thus distinguish views of the same page from views of different references without receiving their implementations.
Before a request can be written, we also need to establish which reference properties these images actually expose. Gemini 3.1 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2026 ) profiles the frames along the six visual dimensions in § 3.2 , providing a description of the visible evidence and a rich , weak , or none label for each dimension. These profiles connect reference collection to query synthesis: they restrict the assignment of reference-dependent requirements to properties supported by the supplied images, rather than by information available only in the underlying webpage.
blocks.zh:
所储存的网页是建筑资产,但显示给代理人的参考文献仅由图像所组成. 为了制作这些视觉投入,"Playwright"使每页都以1920×1080 1920\times 1080取景口并捕捉被脚本卷轴和交互状态,产生出5,522帧横跨水池. 对于传统风格的合成页,我们保留了他们的原版页面特定演示脚本. 对于模板衍生和非典型的页面,我们从所测量的页面高度和可用的悬浮目标(通过已知的选取者或DOM检测确定)生成脚本,交叉相继滚动,徘徊和短暂的暂停. 我们保留了捕捉动作脚本和每个页面的有时间标注的框架,这样所产生的图像仍然与产生它们的行动和源相关. 当引用被组装成任务时,框架顺序和源页边界都会被保留. 因此,代理人可以将同一页的观点与不同参考文献的观点区分开来,而无需收到其执行。
在写出请求之前,我们还需要确定这些图像实际暴露的参考属性. 双子座 3.1 Pro (Google DeepMind, 2026) 第 3.2 节中按照六个视觉维度来描述帧, 提供了可见证据的描述, 以及每个维度的丰富,弱, 或者没有标签. 这些配置文件将参考文献集与查询综合连接起来:它们将依赖参考文献的要求分配到所提供图像所支持的属性,而不是仅仅在基本网页上提供的信息。

blocks.en: B.2 Controlled Task Construction
blocks.zh: B.2 控制下的任务建设

blocks.en: We construct each user request from a structured recipe that combines the reference-use specification in § 3.3 with choices about the target webpage and how the user expresses their needs. The target domain is drawn from a taxonomy of 8 broad categories, 40 subcategories, and 206 site types, ranging from productivity tools such as kanban boards to salon booking pages and API documentation. The recipe also selects one of 14 user profiles, each defining an identity, priorities, and speaking style. For example, a shop owner may emphasize contact details in everyday language, whereas a front-end engineer focuses on semantic structure and responsive behavior.
blocks.zh: 我们从一个结构化的食谱构建每个用户请求,该食谱将第3.3节中的参考使用规格与目标网页的选择以及用户如何表达他们的需要结合起来. 目标域取自由8个大类,40个子类和206个站点类型组成的分类学,从kanban板等生产力工具到沙龙预订页和API文档. 食谱还选择了14个用户配置中的一个,每个用户配置定义一个身份,优先级,和说话风格. 例如,店主可能以日常语言强调联系细节,而前端工程师则注重语义结构和反应行为.

blocks.en: The recipe also controls the intended page’s functional complexity, content density, and explicit constraints. Functional complexity ranges from static pages to stateful applications and data visualization. Up to three tags specify requirements concerning audience, presentation, content volume, delivery, tone, or functionality. These can call for mobile-first display, long-form text, image-led content, offline operation, or bilingual switching. Concrete visual requirements, such as body text of at least 18px, a specified brand color, or square-cornered buttons, are recorded independently of the references.
blocks.zh: 配方还控制预定页面的功能复杂性、内容密度和明确的限制。 功能复杂性从静态页面到状态应用程序和数据可视化不等. 最多三个标签规定了关于受众、展示、内容量、交付、语气或功能的要求。 这些可以要求移动先显示,长式文本,由图像引导的内容,离线操作,或双语切换. 具体的视觉要求,如至少18px的正文,指定的品牌颜色,或正方形的按钮,是独立于引用记录的.

blocks.en: Separately, we sample the language, form, and level of detail of the request. Requests are written in Chinese or English and take the form of flowing prose, casual messages, a flat list of requirements, or a structured product requirements document (PRD) with section headings and acceptance criteria. The level of detail is sampled independently of the page’s functional complexity. It ranges from a single overall need, through a brief description of three to five sections, to detailed content, data, and interactions for each section. Target length depends on both form and level of detail and is measured in Chinese characters or English words. Two exemplars matching the request’s language and form guide organization and tone without supplying topics or wording to reuse.
blocks.zh: 单独地,我们抽取了请求的语言,形式和详细程度. 请求书以中文或英文写成,形式包括流传的散文、散文、统一的要求清单,或结构化产品要求文件,并有章节标题和接受标准。 详细程度与页面的功能复杂性无关。 它从单一的总体需要,到对三至五节的简要说明,到每一节的详细内容、数据和互动。 目标长度取决于形式和详细程度,并以汉字或英文单词来测量. 两个实例与请求的语言相匹配,形成指导组织和语气,而不提供重复使用的专题或措辞.

blocks.en: Gemini 3.1 Pro then converts the recipe and ordered screenshot groups into a natural-language request using the prompt in Fig. 10 . The prompt asks the model to identify each source by its appearance or position and explain how its selected properties should inform the design. Each reference is used only for the specified aspects of the page, and its content is not reused. Explicit values, such as the 18px minimum for body text, must be preserved so that constraints remain checkable after rewording. Visual descriptions must be grounded in the screenshots; motion that is not visible in them is phrased as a new user requirement. We retain the resulting request with its recipe for keypoint construction. Fig. 8 shows three examples with different forms and user profiles.
blocks.zh: 双子座3.1 Pro然后将食谱转换并命令截图组使用Fig. 10中的快取键将截图组变成自然语言请求. 提示请模型通过外观或位置识别出每个源并解释其所选属性应如何告知设计. 每个引用只用于页面的特定方面,其内容不重复使用. 明确值,如正文文字的18px最小值,必须保留,使约束在重写后仍然可以被核对. 视觉描述必须基于截图;其中不可见的动作被用新用户要求来表示. 我们保留了由此产生的要求及其关键点构建方法。 图8显示三个有不同形式和用户简介的例子。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Generated user query examples. English requests from the final task set illustrate casual, bulleted, and structured PRD forms. Task 132 is shown in full; Tasks 279 and 161 are excerpted, with [...] marking omissions. Original wording is retained.
blocks.zh: 图8:生成的用户查询示例. 最终任务集的英文请求说明了临时、中和结构化的PRD表格。 任务132完整显示;任务279和161被摘录,有[.]标记遗漏. 保留了原文。

blocks.en: B.3 Keypoint Construction and Quality Assurance
blocks.zh: B.3 关键点建设和质量保证

blocks.en: Keypoint construction must preserve the reference relationships established during query synthesis while also covering the content and functionality expressed in the completed request. We handle these two parts separately. Reference assignments and explicit textual constraints are converted programmatically into fixed items from the structured specification, retaining their intended sources and requirement types. Claude Opus 5 ( Anthropic, 2026f ) then reads the user request and adds keypoints for content, structure, navigation, and functionality without rewriting the fixed items. This division keeps the specified reference relationships intact while allowing the keypoints to cover requirements that emerge in the natural-language request.
blocks.zh: 关键点构建必须保留在查询综合过程中建立的参考关系,同时涵盖完成的请求中表达的内容和功能. 我们分别处理这两个部分。 参考任务和明确的文字限制在方案上从结构化规格转换成固定项目,保留其预期来源和要求类型。 Claude Opus 5 (Anthropic, 2026f) 之后读取用户请求并添加内容,结构,导航和功能等关键点而无需重写固定项目. 这种划分保留了指定的参考关系,同时允许关键点覆盖自然语言请求中出现的要求.

blocks.en: To make the added keypoints assessable, the construction prompt (Fig. 12 ) links each criterion to both the user request and the evidence needed to evaluate it. Each item must first cite the supporting request text and clarify what it checks: the existence of an element, the correctness of its implementation, or the precision of its details. Distinguishing these levels prevents the mere presence of an element from being treated as sufficient evidence that it has been implemented as instructed. The resulting criterion must then be answerable from the evidence available during evaluation, ruling out questions requiring source-code inspection or unavailable timing measurements. For interaction-dependent requirements, this also means identifying both the control and the action needed to reach the relevant state, so that the subsequent browser-capture process can expose the behavior being assessed.
blocks.zh: 为了使新增的要害点可以评估,构建提示(图12)将每个标准与用户的要求以及评价它所需的证据联系起来。 每个项目必须首先引用支持请求的文本并澄清其检查的内容:存在一个要素、其执行的正确性或其细节的准确性。 区分这些水平不能仅仅将某一要素的存在视为已按指示加以执行的充分证据。 因此,由此产生的标准必须从评价期间掌握的证据中解答,排除需要源码检查或无法测量时间的问题。 对于依赖交互的要求,这也意味着既要确定控制,又要确定达到相关状态所需的行动,这样之后的浏览器-抓取过程就可以暴露被评估的行为.

blocks.en: The generated keypoints are then reviewed by GPT-5.6 Sol ( OpenAI, 2026c ) with high reasoning effort and the prompt shown in Fig. 13 . The review separates completeness from item validity: a global pass first proposes missing requirements, after which a local pass examines individual items and returns keep , modify , or remove , together with a reason. Both passes use the reference-use specification to check whether the criteria preserve the intended task. In particular, an ignored dimension must not introduce a requirement, an adaptation must not become an exact-match demand, and an inversion must not reward copying. These checks address errors that could otherwise make a correct implementation appear unsuccessful. Generation and model review use a configured maximum output of 128,000 tokens. Finally, the expert review described in § 3 revises the keypoints before they are used for evaluation. Fig. 11 presents the instruction template for expert keypoint review.
blocks.zh: 然后由GPT-5.6 Sol(OpenAI, 2026c.)对生成的键点进行审查,并进行高推理努力并用图13所显示的快取. 审查将完整性与项目有效性区分开来:全球通行证首先提出缺失要求,然后由当地通行证审查单个项目,并保存、修改或删除这些单项及其理由。 两个通行证都使用参考使用规格,检查标准是否保留了预定的任务. 特别是,一个被忽略的方面不得引入要求,适应不得成为确切的对等要求,倒置不得奖励抄袭. 这些检查解决了本来可能使正确执行失败的错误。 生成和模型审查使用配置的最大输出为128,000个令牌. 最后,第3节所描述的专家审查在用于评价之前对关键点作了修订。 图11介绍了专家关键点审查的指导模板。

blocks.en: The final benchmark contains 300 tasks, each pairing a user request and ordered reference screenshots with a verified set of keypoints. Together, these tasks use 534 distinct webpages in 972 reference assignments and expose 3,491 reference frames. Stable task identifiers and input hashes preserve the correspondence between each request, its references, and its evaluation specification when these components are passed to the execution and judging stages.
blocks.zh: 最终基准包含300个任务,每个任务将一个用户请求对齐,并命令使用一组经过核实的密钥截图. 这些任务加在一起,在972个参考任务中使用了534个不同的网页,并暴露出3 491个参考框架. 稳定的任务识别符和输入散列保持了每项请求、其参考文献以及这些组成部分传递到执行和判断阶段的评价规格之间的对应关系。

blocks.en: B.4 Standardized Agentic Execution
blocks.zh: B.4 标准化代理执行

blocks.en: With the task components fixed, execution exposes only the information intended for the evaluated agent: the user request, ordered reference images, and an environment brief. The verified keypoints remain hidden and are used later by the evaluator. All released runs use OpenCode 1.18.25 with the same 100-turn cap, implementing the shared coding-agent setting described in § 4.1 .
blocks.zh: 任务组件被固定后,执行只暴露给被评估代理人的信息:用户请求,命令的参考图像,以及一份环境简报. 经核实的关键点仍然被隐藏,稍后由评估人员使用。 所有已发行的运行都使用同为100个圆顶的OpenCode 1.18.25,执行§ 4.1所描述的共享编码代理设置.

blocks.en: The environment brief is matched to the language of the request and explains both the required deliverable and the available development workflow. It asks the agent to “write the finished page to index.html ,” requires a single HTML file, and states that “grading renders the page offline.” It also describes the inspection loop explicitly as “draft → \rightarrow screenshot → \rightarrow compare → \rightarrow fix → \rightarrow screenshot again.” To make this loop executable, the workspace provides shell and file-editing tools together with a Playwright-based shot.py helper. The helper renders the current HTML at widths of 1920, 768, and 390 pixels and returns image paths along with page height, console errors, and attempted external requests. These outputs allow the agent to inspect its rendered implementation and identify problems before revising the page.
blocks.zh: 环境简报与请求的语言相匹配,并解释了所需交付品和现有的发展工作流程。 它要求代理商“将完成的页面写入索引.html ” 需要一个单独的HTML文件,并声明“分级使页面离线”。 还明确将检查圈描述为“右手截图草稿”和“右手截图比较”和“右手截图草稿”。 为了让这个环路可执行,工作空间提供了 shell 和文件编辑工具以及基于 Playwright 的镜头. 小帮手 帮助器使当前HTML的宽度达到1920,768和390像素并随着页面高度,控制台错误,以及尝试的外部请求返回图像路径. 这些产出使该代理人能够在修改网页之前检查其执行结果并找出问题。

blocks.en: Network access remains available during development, but it does not relax the offline submission requirement. Dependencies must be inlined in the final page so that its evaluation does not rely on external resources. Likewise, the availability of development tools does not grant access to benchmark data, hidden criteria, or original reference implementations. Such access is denied and audited. At completion, we retain one official artifact per model–task pair, together with a run record containing the enforced limits, stop reason, transport attempts, token usage, and artifact hashes. This record links the webpage evaluated downstream to the trajectory and resource use reported for that run.
blocks.zh: 开发期间网络接入仍然可用,但并不放松离线提交要求. 依赖性必须在最后一页中加以说明,使其评价不依赖外部资源。 同样,发展工具的提供也不允许获得基准数据、隐藏标准或原始参考执行。 这种访问被拒绝并接受审计。 在完成后,我们保留了每对模型-任务配对的一款官方文物,以及包含强制限制、停止理由、运输尝试、象征性使用和文物散列的运行记录。 这一记录将下游评估的网页与所报告的该运行的轨迹和资源使用情况相连接。

blocks.en: B.5 Evidence Collection and Dual-Track Judging
blocks.zh: B.5 证据收集和双轨判断

blocks.en: The agent’s inspection tools support development, but the evidence used for scoring is collected separately from the submitted index.html . This distinction ensures that the evaluator examines the final webpage through its own capture and measurement procedure rather than relying on the views the agent happened to inspect. The hidden keypoints guide this procedure by identifying the states and properties that need to be exposed. The resulting evidence is then passed to the programmatic and VLM judging tracks described in § 4.3 .
blocks.zh: 代理人的检查工具支持开发,但用于打分的证据与提交的索引.html分开收集。 这种区分确保了评估人员通过自己的捕获和测量程序审查最后网页,而不是依赖代理人检查时所持的观点。 隐藏的关键点通过识别需要暴露的状态和属性来指导这一程序. 由此产生的证据随后转交给第4.3节所描述的方案和VLM判断轨迹。

blocks.en: Playwright/Chromium first renders the artifact at 1920 × 1080 1920\times 1080 , with a target of five to ten distinct primary frames. Since requirements can concern states that are not visible on initial load, a deterministic action planner uses the keypoints to plan at most eight states to expose. For each item, it tries up to four candidate controls and allows 900 ms for a state transition. These settings govern how the browser attempts to obtain the interaction evidence specified during keypoint construction.
blocks.zh: Playwright/Chrimium在1920×1080 1920\times 1080首先制造出文物,目标为5到10个不同的主帧. 由于要求可能涉及在初始负载上看不到的状态,因此确定性行动计划者利用关键点在最多8个州进行计划以暴露. 对于每个项目,它尝试最多4个候选控制,并允许900毫秒的状态过渡. 这些设置规范了浏览器如何试图获取键点构建时指定的交互证据.

blocks.en: The evaluator also measures the page at widths of 1280, 768, and 390 pixels to assess behavior beyond the primary desktop view. Additional stress fixtures test robustness when content differs from the initial presentation: eligible collections are replaced with zero or 300 rows, an 80-character unbroken string is injected, and mixed CJK/emoji content is supplied. The resulting measurements complement the ordinary rendered views by exposing behavior under narrow layouts and abnormal content. If a measurement is unavailable or inapplicable, that status is recorded explicitly. The absence of a usable measurement is not treated as evidence that the corresponding test succeeded.
blocks.zh: 评审人员还以1280,768和390像素的宽度测量页面,以评估主桌面视图之外的行为. 当内容与最初的演示不同时,额外的应力定型测试坚固性:合格的集合被取而代之为0行或300行,注入了80个特征的未断弦,并提供了混合的CJK/emoji内容. 由此产生的测量结果通过在狭义布局下暴露行为和异常内容来补充普通渲染的观点. 如果无法或不适用计量,则明确记录这一状况。 没有可用计量不被视为证明相应测试成功的证据。

blocks.en: For program-verifiable keypoints, the collected browser measurements determine pass/fail verdicts. Requirements that need semantic or perceptual interpretation are instead assigned to Gemini 3.1 pro, configured with high thinking level and a maximum output of 65,535 tokens. This judge receives visual and measured evidence rather than the submitted HTML, reference source code, or solver identity. Its task is to assess what the webpage demonstrates against the stated requirement, rather than infer success from implementation claims.
blocks.zh: 对于程序可验证的密钥点,所收集的浏览器测量决定了通过/失败的判断. 需要语义或知觉解释的要求则被分配给双子座 3.1 pro,配置为高思维水平并最大输出为65,535个令牌. 这个法官接收视觉和被测量的证据,而不是所提交的HTML,参考源代码,或解析器身份. 其任务是对照所述要求评估网页显示的情况,而不是推断执行要求是否成功。

blocks.en: The perceptual judge processes batches of 5 keypoints, with a separate assessment for each item. Each batch contains the user request, the supporting basis for each item, the reference assignments, and normalized browser facts. To keep these facts and images interpretable, the images follow a fixed order: reference frames, up to ten main artifact views, up to two views per narrow viewport, and up to two stress-fixture views. An accompanying manifest identifies the groups, making clear which images describe the reference and which show the submitted page under each evaluation condition.
blocks.zh: 洞察法官处理分批5个关键点,对每个项目分别进行评估。 每批包含用户请求,每个项目的支撑基础,参考任务,以及规范的浏览器事实. 为了保持这些事实和图像的可解释性,图像遵循了固定的顺序:参考框,最多可有十种主要文物取景,每个狭窄的取景口最多可有两处取景,以及最多可有两处压力固定取景. 随附的明细表列明了各组,明确了哪些图像描述了参考文献,哪些显示每个评价条件下提交的页面.

blocks.en: Before assigning a rating, the judge must record the expected requirement, the observed evidence, and the deviation between them. This sequence asks it to establish a concrete comparison before choosing a score. Fig. 14 presents these audit instructions and the rating rubric. The full template also specifies evidence handling and exceptions for unavailable external inputs. The resulting item scores are combined with core-function evidence using the aggregation rule in § 4.3 . We retain render manifests, measurements, action outcomes, and item verdicts separately, allowing the recorded judgments to be inspected and the scores to be re-aggregated without another model call.
blocks.zh: 在给予评分之前,法官必须记录预期要求、观察到的证据及其之间的偏差。 这个序列要求它在选择分数前建立具体的比较. 图14列出了这些审计指示和评级标题。 完整的模板还具体规定了无法提供的外部投入的证据处理和例外。 由此产生的项目分数与使用第4.3节中的汇总规则的核心职能证据相结合。 我们保留了单项清单、计量、行动结果和项目判断,从而可以检查记录的判断,并重新汇总分数,而无需再做一次模型调试。

blocks.en: Figure 9: An end-to-end development trajectory on Task 163. Boxes and enlarged screenshot crops highlight reference cues, responsive-layout revisions, and changes in the quote and booking state.
blocks.zh: 图 9:任务163的端到端发展轨迹. 方框和拓宽的截图作物突出显示参考提示、反应式显示修改以及引文和预订状态的变化。

blocks.en: Every single thing you say about these pages must be pinned to the page it applies to — what you want taken from one, and equally what you saw on one and do not want. A reader holding the screenshots has to be able to tell, for each of your asks, which page you meant.
blocks.zh: 你对这些页面所说的每件事,都必须被固定在它适用于的一页上——你想要从一页中取出的东西,同样你看到在一页上而不希望的东西。 一个持有截图的读者必须能够分辨, 对于你的每一个要求, 你指的是哪一页。

blocks.en: Never ask for a page to be followed as a whole. No "basically make it look like this one", no "follow the first one overall", no "same vibe as that page overall". You are cherry-picking, and a blanket instruction would silently override your own picks. If you catch yourself writing a sentence that gives one page general authority over the design, cut it.
blocks.zh: 永远不要要求一个页面被整体跟踪. 没有“基本上使它看起来像这一页”,没有“遵循第一个总体”,没有“与该页总体相同”。 你挑樱桃, 和毛毯指示会 沉默地压倒你自己的选。 如果你发现自己写了一个句子 给一页对设计的一般授权,就切掉它。

blocks.en: Before writing any visual detail — corner radius, shadow, border, weight, contrast, density — find it in the right page’s screenshots first. If you cannot point at it, do not write it.
blocks.zh: 在写出任何视觉细节——角半径,阴影,边框,重量,对比度,密度——之前,先在右页的截图中找到. 如果你不能指向它, 不要写它。

blocks.en: Attributing a real detail to the wrong page is just as bad as inventing one. Read the notes above and keep them straight: the colours you liked are on one page, the cards on another.
blocks.zh: 对错误的一页给出真实的细节 和发明的一页一样糟糕 阅读上面的注释并保持直线:你喜欢的颜色在一页上,卡片在一页上.

blocks.en: The specific value has to survive. Reword the sentence however suits you, but the actual thing — that typeface, that colour, that size, that many columns, those corners — must still be there and still be checkable by someone who never sees the screenshots.
blocks.zh: 具体价值必须活下来. 重写句子无论多么适合你,但实际的事情——那个打字相,那个颜色,那个大小,许多柱子,那些角落——必须仍然在那里,并且仍然可以被从未看到截图的人检查.

blocks.en: Output ONLY the JSON object below — no markdown fences, no explanation.
blocks.zh: 仅输出下方的 JSON 对象——没有减值栅栏,也没有解释.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Prompt for user-query generation. Across all prompt figures, [...] denotes omitted passages. Formatting and line breaks are adjusted for presentation.
blocks.zh: 图10: 快速生成用户-query。 在所有迅速的数字中,[.]表示省略了段落。 格式和换行符按列报方式进行调整。

blocks.en: Check coverage against the task. Identify the requested content, structure, navigation, visual properties, and essential behavior, then check whether the checklist covers them. Add missing requirements with a supporting basis. If a function is implicit but necessary to fulfill the stated task, explain that necessity explicitly. Do not add personal design preferences or optional conventions.
blocks.zh: 检查覆盖与任务。 识别所请求的内容,结构,导航,视觉属性,以及基本行为,然后检查核对表是否涵盖它们. 添加缺少的、有支持依据的要求。 如果某项职能是隐含的,但履行所述任务所必需,请明确解释这一必要性。 不添加个人设计偏好或任择公约。

blocks.en: Ground each item in the correct evidence. Quote the relevant request text and, for a reference-dependent property, identify the source page and frame supporting it. Confirm that the cited feature is visible and belongs to that reference. Remove invented details and unsupported requirements. If the request, screenshots, and specification conflict, flag the inconsistency rather than silently changing the task.
blocks.zh: 把每件物品都放在正确的证据中 引用相关请求文本,并针对依赖引用的属性,确定源页面并框支持. 确认所引用的特性可见并属于该参考. 删除已发明的细节和不支持的要求 。 如果请求、截图和规格冲突,标出不一致之处,而不是默默地改变任务。

blocks.en: Preserve the intended reference relationship. Check each constrained dimension against its assigned requirement type: • copy : assess the requested property against the assigned reference. • adapt : assess the selected characteristics and requested transformation, without adding exact-match demands. • invert : assess the requested departure from the reference, not similarity to it. • specify : follow the explicit textual constraint rather than importing a reference property. • ignore : do not introduce a requirement for the unconstrained dimension.
blocks.zh: 保留预定的参考关系. 对照指定的要求类型检查每个受限制的维度: 副本: 根据指定的参考文献评估请求的财产。 • 适应:评估选定的特性和要求的转换,但不增加精确匹配的需求。 · 倒置:评估要求偏离参考之处,而不是与之相类似。 • 具体说明:遵循明确的文字限制,而不是输入参考财产。 • 忽略:不要对不受限制的方面提出要求。

blocks.en: copy : assess the requested property against the assigned reference.
blocks.zh: 副本:根据指定的参考文献评估请求的财产。

blocks.en: adapt : assess the selected characteristics and requested transformation, without adding exact-match demands.
blocks.zh: 适应 : 评估选定的特性和要求的转换,而不添加精确匹配的要求。

blocks.en: invert : assess the requested departure from the reference, not similarity to it.
blocks.zh: 倒置 : 评估请求的偏离引用,而不是与之相类似.

blocks.en: specify : follow the explicit textual constraint rather than importing a reference property.
blocks.zh: 指定:遵循明确的文字约束,而不是导入参考属性。

blocks.en: ignore : do not introduce a requirement for the unconstrained dimension.
blocks.zh: 忽略:不要对不受约束的维度提出要求。

blocks.en: Make the criteria specific and verifiable. Each item should assess one requirement without duplicating another. Distinguish existence, correctness, and precision, and do not invent numerical tolerances. For interactions, name the control, action, and observable outcome. Check that the criterion can be judged from rendered views or available browser measurements, not source-code claims or unseen behavior. Use programmatic checks where reliable measurement is available and perceptual judgment otherwise. Flag incorrect source, dimension, depth, importance, or judging-track annotations.
blocks.zh: 使标准具体和可核查。 每个项目应评估一项要求,而不应重复另一项要求。 区别存在,正确性和精确性,不发明数字容忍. 对于相互作用,请指定控制、行动和可观察到的结果。 请检查date=中的日期值 (帮助) 校对:Soup 在有可靠衡量方法的地方使用方案检查,否则就进行概念判断。 旗帜错误的源,尺寸,深度,重要性,或判断-轨道说明.

blocks.en: Return an auditable revision. Mark each existing item as keep , modify , or remove , and label new items add . Preserve existing identifiers. For every change or addition, provide the revised wording where applicable, supporting evidence, corrected annotations, and a brief reason. Return the revised checklist with a separate list of unresolved ambiguities or missing evidence. Do not approve unresolved items by assumption or change the scoring rubric and aggregation rule.
blocks.zh: 退回可审计的修订。 将每个已存在的项目标为保存、修改或删除,并标为新项目。 保存现有标识符. 对于每一改动或增加,请酌情提供订正后的措辞、佐证、更正后的说明和简单的理由。 退回订正核对表,单列未解决的模糊之处或缺失的证据。 不按假设核准未解决的项目,也不改变分数和汇总规则。
